description: vite's CSS transformer. The npm tarball ships no Rust source, so the git route takes the tagged tree. Provenance is not cross-checked: the release publishes no attestation, and upstream moved the v<version> tag one commit past the gitHead the packument names (the tag adds only rust-toolchain.toml, which this build does not read). The one cdylib, lightningcss_node, stands in for lightningcss-linux-x64-{gnu,musl}. Versions: 0.0.0 is a name placeholder whose tarball holds only package.json (no binding, no optionalDependencies), and 1.21.4, 1.21.7, 1.28.1, 1.29.1 and 1.31.1 have no v<version> tag upstream (git ls-remote), so the git route cannot clone them; those are denied. Loader: up to 1.31.1 node/index.js assigns module.exports = require(the platform binding), handing the binding over whole; from 1.32.0 it wraps named exports off `native`. Profile: upstream's release profile is already panic=abort; its wasm build (wasm:build-release) runs wasm-opt without -g, which drops the name section, so the recipe strips symbols.
